themes.name: Catppuccin Mocha
themes.toml:
# Catppuccin Mocha.
# Palette: Catppuccin palette (github.com/catppuccin/catppuccin, MIT).
# Which colour fills which slot is this repository's choice.

[meta]
id = "catppuccin-mocha"
name = "Catppuccin Mocha"
dark = true
description = "Soothing pastels on deep indigo, with mauve for focus."
author = "Catppuccin"
source = "Catppuccin palette (github.com/catppuccin/catppuccin, MIT)"

[palette]
background = "#181825"
surface = "#1e1e2e"
surface_alt = "#313244"
border = "#313244"
border_strong = "#6c7086"
text = "#cdd6f4"
text_strong = "#f5e0dc"
text_muted = "#a6adc8"
accent = "#cba6f7"
on_accent = "#11111b"
live = "#94e2d5"
positive = "#a6e3a1"
negative = "#f38ba8"
warning = "#f9e2af"
info = "#89b4fa"

[chart]
series = ["#cba6f7", "#89b4fa", "#a6e3a1", "#fab387", "#f38ba8", "#f9e2af", "#94e2d5", "#f5c2e7"]
grid = "#313244"

[fuel]
coal = "#7f849c"
gas = "#fab387"
nuclear = "#cba6f7"
wind = "#89b4fa"
solar = "#f9e2af"
hydro = "#74c7ec"
storage = "#94e2d5"
imports = "#cdd6f4"
other = "#585b70"

[style]
rounding = 4.0
spacing = 6.0
padding = 8.0
stroke = 1.0
shadow_offset = 0.0
chamfer = 0.0

[fonts]
body = { family = "IBM Plex Sans", weight = 400, size = 14.0 }
mono = { family = "JetBrains Mono", weight = 400, size = 13.0 }
heading = { family = "IBM Plex Sans", weight = 600, size = 16.0 }
label = { family = "IBM Plex Sans", weight = 600, size = 11.0 }
readout = { family = "JetBrains Mono", weight = 500, size = 24.0 }

themes.name: Everforge Dark
themes.toml:
# Generated by `cargo run -p mt-theme --example sync_everforge` from Everforge tokens v3.
# Do not edit by hand: change the tokens in the Everforge repo and re-run the sync.

[meta]
id = "everforge-dark"
name = "Everforge Dark"
dark = true
author = "Aren Desai"
description = "Neutral graphite plates, brass fittings, rust for faults, mint-neon for anything live."
source = "Everforge design tokens v3 (dist/json/everforge.json)"

[palette]
background = "#16191a"
surface = "#1e2223"
surface_alt = "#283127"
border = "#343a3a"
border_strong = "#7f8886"

text_strong = "#f2f1ea"

accent = "#a7c080"
on_accent = "#16191a"
live = "#6ef0b0"
positive = "#83c092"
negative = "#e67e80"
warning = "#dbbc7f"
info = "#7fbbb3"

[chart]
series = [
    "#a7c080",
    "#dbbc7f",
    "#7fbbb3",
    "#d699b6",
    "#83c092",
    "#6ef0b0",
    "#7f8886",
    "#e67e80",
]
grid = "#343a3a"

[fuel]
coal = "#7f8886"
gas = "#a7c080"
hydro = "#83c092"
imports = "#d9d8d0"
nuclear = "#d699b6"
other = "#9a9e9a"
solar = "#dbbc7f"
storage = "#6ef0b0"
wind = "#7fbbb3"

[style]
rounding = 2.0
spacing = 6.0
padding = 8.0
stroke = 1.0
shadow_offset = 2.0
chamfer = 8.0

[fonts.body]
family = "IBM Plex Sans"
weight = 400
size = 14.0

[fonts.mono]
family = "JetBrains Mono"
weight = 400
size = 13.0

[fonts.heading]
family = "Space Grotesk"
weight = 600
size = 17.0

[fonts.label]
family = "Space Grotesk"
weight = 600
size = 11.0

[fonts.readout]
family = "Space Grotesk"
weight = 500
size = 26.0
